vlog_arc.theme: What it actually costs to build something that matters.

beats.mon: Leo on camera at 5am before training: 'This week I want to show you what building Power Coffee actually costs — not in dollars, in decisions.'
beats.tue: Leo at his desk reviewing ingredient supplier data: 'I turned down a cheaper source today — I'll show you exactly why the formula can't move on price.'
beats.wed: Leo at a café, coffee in hand, watching people at laptops: 'Every person in here will crash by 2pm — I built something for that moment, and most of them don't know it exists yet.'
beats.thu: Leo recording a voice note while walking: 'Got a message from a customer this morning — day three, something shifted — I'll read it to you and tell you why that specific phrase matters to me.'
beats.fri: Leo at home, kids audible in the background: 'End of the week. We shipped. We didn't cut corners. Gabriel asked me what I was proud of today — I had an honest answer.'
beats.sat: Leo on a long training run, talking to camera afterward: 'Two hours in the dark before anyone needs me — this is the only way I know how to show up fully for my family and for this company.'
beats.sun: Leo quiet, sitting with coffee: 'I don't know exactly where this is going. But I know why I started. That's enough to start another week.'

ig.title: Your crash isn't caffeine. It's blood sugar.
ig.angle: Hook with the 11am wall everyone recognizes, then reframe the villain — it was never the coffee, it was the formula.

ig.title: Day 1 skeptical. Day 3 something shifted.
ig.angle: Use a real buyer timeline arc to mirror audience resistance and dissolve the 'what if it doesn't work' objection before it forms.

ig.title: Two hours before my family wakes up.
ig.angle: Show Leo's pre-dawn Ironman training block and the exact moment Power Coffee fits into a dad's non-negotiable morning — real stakes, zero hype.

ig.title: Why functional coffee beats an energy drink.
ig.angle: Declarative carousel: lay out the mechanism difference (sustained vs spike) with Leo's voice, ending on a framework the audience can share.

ig.title: The tree that survived a nuclear blast.
ig.angle: Lead with the Ginkgo origin claim as a pattern-interrupt hook, then reveal how it ends up in every bag — curiosity drives the scroll.

x.title: Functional coffee is not a coffee upgrade.
x.angle: Short thread reframing Power Coffee as a category of its own — not 'better coffee' but a different tool entirely, for a different outcome.

x.title: I'm building this company in public.
x.angle: Declarative thread: Leo shares one real number, one real setback, and one real win from the week — anti-marketing framing drives replies.

x.title: $0.73 a morning. No crash. Real focus.
x.angle: Price math post that reframes cost against the daily latte and the afternoon Red Bull — disarms the objection before it forms.

x.title: Why I chose adaptogens over more caffeine.
x.angle: Thread walking through Leo's formulation logic: the ingredient decision, the tradeoff, and what the science actually says — teach, don't sell.

x.title: I built this with AI. Not hiding it.
x.angle: Declarative confession thread using the proven radical-transparency template — name the expected objection, refuse to apologize, invite the debate.

li.title: I spent two years formulating this coffee.
li.angle: Founder-narrated ingredient science post anchored in personal stakes — what problem Leo was solving for himself before he solved it for anyone else.

li.title: The functional beverage market is lying to founders.
li.angle: Industry POV post exposing the gap between 'functional' label claims and actual ingredient dosages — positions Leo as the honest insider.

li.title: A review stopped me mid-scroll last week.
li.angle: Story-frame the social proof: open with Leo's reaction to a specific buyer review, then unpack why that one comment validated the formula — no ad-copy headline.

li.title: Energy drinks are a productivity tax.
li.angle: Reframe the real cost of spike-and-crash cycles in a founder's workday — lost output hours, not just jitters — then offer the mechanism alternative.

li.title: Three questions I ask every ingredient supplier.
li.angle: Framework post: Leo's sourcing checklist turned into a repeatable tool readers can screenshot and share — teaching earns authority on LinkedIn.

tg.title: What Monday morning actually looks like here.

tg.title: 430 mornings. One formula. Here's the data.
tg.angle: Drop a specific number with context — not a testimonial, Leo's own streak — then open the floor for community members to share their own day count.

tg.title: Coffee isn't the problem. The formula is.

tg.title: The ingredient nobody talks about in coffee.
tg.angle: Educational drop: one underdog ingredient, its mechanism explained in two sentences, and why it's in every bag — community gets the insider briefing first.

tg.title: Gabriel asked me what I was building today.
tg.angle: A short personal moment: Leo's kid's question reframed as the real reason the company exists — faith, family, mission — lands warmly in a close-knit channel.

blog.angle: Deep-dive framework comparing mechanism, ingredient quality, and cost-per-outcome — designed to rank for purchase-intent search and be referenced across channels.

em.angle: Founder personal note: a real family moment that explains the mission better than any product page — warms the list and deepens brand loyalty.
